about: A dine-in and takeout Mexican taqueria at 5003 St. Charles Road serving tacos, tortas, burritos and plates, plus soups and seafood like caldo de pescado and shrimp cocktail. Menudo and pozole are served as a weekend special.
tagline: Tortas, burritos and weekend menudo on St. Charles Road
hours: Not confirmed from an official source. Restaurantji listing: Mon & Wed 9am–6pm; Tue, Thu–Sun 9am–7pm. In-store sign (photo) advertised weekday breakfast 9–11:30am.
notes: No website or online-ordering page found. Facebook page found via Restaurantji but could not be read (blocked). Menu items and phone come from a photo of the restaurant's printed takeout menu (shows 5003 St Charles Rd, Bellwood). Hours unverified.
